newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait air cargo up 15 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait air cargo up 15 pct in January.

text.p: Kuwait airport cargo volume rose 15 percent in January to 11,478 tonnes compared to the previous January, the civil aviation directorate said.

The monthly study by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation said outbound cargo volume rose 18 percent to 3,782 tonnes during the same period while incoming cargo rose by 13 percent to 7,696 tonnes.
It said the national flag carrier Kuwait Airways Corp handled 71 percent of total cargo in January, 64 percent of 283,872 passengers who used the airport and 45 percent of total flights of 2,811.
An earlier study put total air cargo through Kuwait's airport in 1996 at 132,900 tonnes, a seven percent rise from the previous year.
